data.name: Forget Her
data.detailed_description:
Forget Her is a first-person psychological horror experience that pulls you into the mystery of Greg and Alison two of your closest friends who disappeared without a word. Their worried parents asked you to check the house, but once you step inside, it’s clear something else lingers there. The walls remember. The silence watches. And the truth is buried deeper than you think.

Gameplay

Explore a suburban home that slowly unravels into a nightmare. Collect notes, objects, and fragments of memory that reveal what really happened between Greg and Alison. Piece together clues, solve the mystery, and gather the items for a ritual that could either banish the entity or trap you forever.

The haunting escalates as you play: lights fail, objects break, and the ghost becomes more aggressive the closer you come to the truth. Your choices where you go, what you find, and how you act determine whether you escape… or join the others.

Key Features

  • Immersive First-Person Horror – See through the eyes of Troy Allen as he searches for his missing friends.

  • Non-Linear Exploration – Choose your path: unlock the attic or dig into the crawlspace first.

  • Environmental Storytelling – Notes, flashback voices, and interactive objects paint a tragic picture of love turned obsession.

  • Puzzle & Code Mechanics – Crack safes, decipher dates, and unlock secrets through logic and environmental clues.

  • Dynamic Hauntings – Lights flicker, glass shatters, and the ghost’s presence intensifies as you progress.

  • Multiple Endings – Complete the ritual correctly for release, or fail and face a darker fate.

  • Atmospheric Sound & Visuals – A tense blend of sound design, lighting, and psychological scares.

Will You Forget Her, or Will She Claim You?

The house doesn’t want to let go. The deeper you go, the more it remembers and the harder it becomes to escape.

data.short_description: Forget Her is a survival psychological horror game where you explore a haunted house, uncover chilling secrets, solve the mystery, and perform a deadly ritual or run.. Can you survive Alison’s ghost and discover the truth?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Performance quality settings in 40 at 1080p. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2080 or AMD Radeon™ RX 6800XT
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on Max settings in 60 FPS at 1080p.

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence and Gore: Depictions of blood, unsettling imagery, and intense sequences designed to frighten or disturb.

Psychological Horror: Story elements that explore fear, trauma, and manipulation.

Strong Language: Occasional use of profanity.

Dark Themes: Includes references to death, abuse, and mental distress that some players may find triggering.
